summary: Deferred request of esv::hit::HitProxySystem: attach a hit proxy once the entity named by a UUID exists (macOS esv::hit::HitProxySystem::RequestAttachHitProxyAfterInit(EntityHandle const&, Guid const&, FixedString const&)). HitProxySystem::ProcessAttachAfterInitRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x3BE210) resolves the Guid through the UUID mapping and, when it resolves, queues an AttachHitProxyRequest (24 bytes: resolved entity, the component's entity, FixedString). Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (server row).

fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2B37660 (AllocRaw 0x18) copies four dwords from its 3rd argument to +0..+0xF; Toolkit ProcessAttachAfterInitRequests resolves the 16 bytes at element +0 with the UUID-to-handle lookup (FUN_1802c1830) and uses the result as the first entity of AttachHitProxyRequest. Guid by the macOS signature of RequestAttachHitProxyAfterInit.

fields.evidence: Creator IncRefs its 4th argument and stores it at +0x10; Toolkit copies `(FixedString *)(element + 0x10)` into the request's FixedString (the same FixedString SE names field_8 in eoc::hit::ProxyComponent).
